name: Whampire
abilities: Corrupturas - spits small crystalline bat-creatures that latch onto a victim's forehead and enslave them; sized to fit the target, and usable as plain projectiles
Corrupturas also control undead beings and supernaturally possessed objects
Life-force draining by biting/sucking - can even feed on a Celestialsapien
Sonic explosion - last-resort blast that hurled Rook, Scout, Rad and a whole mob away
Flight on bat-like arm flaps; bat transformation into a tiny winged form
X-ray vision (sees nerves and energy) and night vision
Enhanced strength (flipped Malgax over), durability (thrown into a wall by Malgax), agility, reflexes, stamina, jumping, smell and hearing
Prehensile feet - hangs upside down ('does his best thinking' that way); quadrupedal running
Space survivability; willpower lets him resist other Vladats' hypnosis
weaknesses: Sunlight burns him - he cannot stay in it long (Blukic and Driba Go to Area 51)
Intense heat (Pyronites, Prypiatosian-Bs, Atomix's species) harms him and destroys his Corrupturas
Corrupturas shatter when the Omnitrix times out, freeing all victims; they are fragile and fail on wet/slimy, intangible or cyborg targets (Exo-Skull), Dagon and strong-willed Vladats
Must resist the urge to drain the life energy of intelligent beings
Sonic explosion also blows away allies
Possibly allergic to garlic; can be scared by Toepick's species
summary: A pale, fanged Vladat in a black-and-green suit who hypnotises, drains life force and enslaves foes with mind-controlling Corrupturas - the last new alien of the Classic continuity.
traits: Speaks with a Hungarian accent in homage to Bela Lugosi's Dracula
Modelled after Marvel's Baron Blood; name puns on the band Wham! and Stoker's 'Count Wampyr'
Only OV alien unlocked by scanning a DNA sample (the resurrected Lord Transyl)
He and Lord Transyl are the only Vladats left in the universe
Chibi bat form is a real power, not a gag
notableFeats: Enslaved Dr. Viktor, Kuphulu and Cruejo with Corrupturas, resisted Lord Transyl's mind control, and stormed Z'Castle Zs'Skayr to fight Lord Transyl and Zs'Skayr (The Vampire Strikes Back)
Blew a hostile Anur Transyl mob away with a sonic explosion (The Vampire Strikes Back)
Freed Max from Malgax, flipped him over and, with Skurd's borrowed alien parts, defeated him (Malgax Attacks)
Defeated Exo-Skull and Subdora (The End of an Era)

notableEpisodes: Blukic and Driba Go to Area 51
appearances.designNotes: Pale-skinned vampire with a large head, green eyes and sharp yellow fangs; black jumpsuit with green chest and markings, black gloves with clawed green fingers, spiked green mask, green bat-wing flaps under the arms; Omnitrix symbol on the stomach. Bat form: small black winged ball with his face.

scoring.rationale: Special 7: hypnosis, life-drain and Corrupturas that turned three Anur monsters into henchmen and beat Exo-Skull and Subdora; a sonic explosion clears rooms. Mobility 7 with flight, bat form and quadrupedal sprinting, and he physically handled Malgax. Sunlight and heat are crippling, Corrupturas are fragile and vanish on time-out, and he must fight the urge to feed.

notes: DNA source: Lord Transyl, scanned in The Vampire Strikes Back after Zs'Skayr resurrected him with Alpha Rune magic. Final new alien introduced in Omniverse and in the Classic continuity.
Malgax Attacks: Skurd gave Whampire Armodrillo's drill, Bloxx-Lobbers, Feedback's hands and Diamondhead's arm/sword/shield/helmet during the fight.
Blukic and Driba Go to Area 51: accidental daytime desert transformation - nearly burned to death until Max switched him to Four Arms.
Albedo cannot transform into Whampire. Wiki 'Vladat' spelling was once suspected to be a misnomer for 'Vladite' but pop-up trivia recordings (2024) confirmed 'Vladat'.
